name: the desk model parses to its documented size
an empty model has no blocks and no slices
comments and blank lines are free and order is kept as written
a block with no fields and no edges
fields keep their declared order and types are kept as spelled
lines: view V z:int a:int m:list[list[int]] o:optional[list[ChatLine]]

canonical: view V z:int a:int m:list[list[int]] o:optional[list[ChatLine]]

name: every segment after the first is an edge, edges are kept as written
lines: command C a:int | refuses z,a | produces E2,E1 | reads V

name: the canonical line puts edges in fixed order and sorts their values
lines: command C a:int | refuses z,a | produces E2,E1 | reads V

canonical: command C a:int | reads V | produces E1,E2 | refuses a,z

name: the canonical line orders consumes before issues and returns before queries
lines: processor P | issues C2,C1 | consumes E2,E1
query Q x:int | returns Page | reads V2,V1
screen S | commands B,A | queries Q

canonical: processor P | consumes E1,E2 | issues C1,C2
query Q x:int | reads V1,V2 | returns Page
screen S | queries Q | commands A,B

name: values are sorted in byte order
white space between tokens may be tabs or runs of spaces
lines: command	C   a:int	 b:string	|	reads	V,W   |   produces    E

canonical: command C a:int b:string | reads V,W | produces E

name: a slice line is a title and a path of block names
lines: slice a story : A -> B -> C

name: a slice title may contain spaces and a slice line may end in a comment
lines: slice send a message and see it  : ChatPanel -> SendMessage -> Said # the story

slices.title: send a message and see it

name: blocks and slices are separated whatever their order in the file
a slice line without a colon is a parse error
a block line with a kind and no name is a parse error
a block line that starts with an edge is a parse error
an edge with a key and no values is a parse error
an empty edge segment is a parse error
